verdict.rationale: Windmill is a workflow/automation platform (not an agent), so publishing an official MCP server is squarely within its category, and docs confirm it: 'With MCP, you can connect your favorite LLMs (like Claude, Cursor, or any MCP compatible client) to Windmill, allowing you to trigger your scripts and flows from your client chat,' corroborated by a probe confirming the official MCP docs page. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the MCP server working in practice beyond first-party docs.
